# FG-GIT-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `concurrency_limit_reports_git_busy` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git の処理が混み合っています。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
- en: The Git backend is busy. Try again later.
- id: Layanan Git sedang sibuk. Coba lagi nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

Every git subprocess slot was in use for longer than the acquire timeout.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Check the git concurrency limit (`GitConfig::max_concurrency`) against the number of concurrent clones/pushes in the access log; long-running operations (large clones) hold slots.

## 対処 (fix)

Raise the git concurrency limit if the host has CPU and IO headroom, or find the operations that hold slots for long.
